tolerances.critical_fit_method: Post-fit and measure. Values are acceptance requirements, not claims about an unidentified printer or supplied stock.
tolerances.surface_status: Finish requirement requires inspection; no supplier certification assumed

support_bank.support_closure: Same manufactured body/gate profiles as hook, fixed mouth-up, manual gate commands. This differs from source latch supports and remains unqualified.
support_bank.contact_status: Slot clearances define rigid geometry only; loop stripping and which stitch strands are retained require contact/topology validation.
support_bank.stripper_compatibility_note: Rigid clearance is a conditional screen; slot side/bottom stripping of compressed yarn and actual loop orientation remain unqualified. Do not infer stripping from rectangular envelope dimensions.
support_bank.stripper_finished_fit: Finish each slot to measured maximum tool width+0.30mm, tolerance +/-0.02mm; lateral centering +/-0.02mm; resulting side gap0.12..0.18mm.

guide.stock: KS8127 brass tube1/8in OD x0.014in wall
guide.route: Yarn through tube lumen, rear payout to front exit. Rear-side presentation. Tube concept differs from source eye shaft; its bend friction and seating remain unqualified.
guide.compatibility_note: 0.6 is proposed admitted diameter ceiling, not a measurement of M782. Verify compressed/free diameter and entry bend before operation.
guide.outer_stock: KS8133 brass tube5/16in OD x0.014in wall
guide.retention: Four all-metal cylindrical bonds with LOCTITE680; main/reducer and reducer/exit15mm overlap, two machined brass10mm bushes. Finish bores before bonding in coaxial fixture; <=0.025mm measured runout; actual-substrate coupon/cure/retention acceptance required.
guide.reducer_stock: KS8126 brass tube3/32in OD x0.014in wall
guide.bushing_material: Machined C260 brass; no as-printed mating surface
guide.bushing_stock: K&S 5/16in solid brass rod or inspected equivalent >=7.2mm diameter

slide.load_status: Manual slow positioning only. Printed play, friction, creep and clamping repeatability require qualification. Nominal sliding contact is intentional.
slide.actuation: Hand push retained carriage; tighten side M3 lock after gauging position. End blocks limit travel. Endpoint repeatability not established.

frame.base_material: cut plywood or flat shop plate; measured flatness requirement 0.5mm over base
frame.feed_status: Ideal reference geometry only. Bearing startup friction, mass including pulley, payout and take-down setpoints remain unqualified; not a released feeder.

M2.standard: ISO4762 screw / ISO4032 nut; dimensions are envelope requirements; verify chosen supplier

M3.standard: ISO4762 screw / ISO4032 nut; dimensions are envelope requirements; verify chosen supplier

physics.brass_E_source: Copper Development Association C26000, 16000ksi; reference typical value, not certified lower bound
physics.guide_force_note: 0.5N transverse guide-load screening ceiling is an authored operating requirement, not measured yarn force. E80000..120000MPa is sensitivity interval, not certified stock bound. No physical release without qualification.

assembly.guide_axis: 20deg below horizontal toward negativeY; rear is higher
assembly.mounting_notes: Guide long thin tube remains continuous; outer sleeve and two bushes support it. No hidden yarn splice. Guide bracket feed passage is offset from the Z carriage.
assembly.guide_withdrawal: Translate upward along the 20-degree tube axis, not horizontal at constant Z. This is a required coordinated path; manual positioning is not a mechanical interlock.
assembly.head_roll_actuation: Rotate barrel, hook, gate, collars and attached screws around localu; bearing, adapter and radial lock stay fixed. Unlock before roll. Continuous roll sweep not assumed clear.
assembly.support_actuation: Each support carriage/holder/tools and own hardware follows q; gate bolt/nut follow gate displacement. Remove index pin except at indexed positions.

stand.assembly: Two cut plywood side panels and one back panel; four printed L brackets; top fasteners use stand nuts instead of foot nuts. Loaded stability and panel stiffness require qualification.

take_down.contact: Two opposed replaceable TPU pads; cloth retained between pads with two M3 screws outside admitted90mm cloth width; mass includes all jaws pads bolts nuts and ballast. Actual no-slip/damage window must be measured.

feeder.bearing_sku: SKF623-2Z exact shielded model; no NSK substitute; receiving and startup torque admission required
feeder.mode: HIGH: counterweight rope parked on fixed cleat; LOW: attach to moving-carrier eye. Manual upstream nip meters payout; accumulator recovers yarn. Counterweight gives nominal0.015N rather than0.063N in ideal frictionless balance. No exact delivered tension claimed.
feeder.mass_balance_requirement: Weigh all moving parts and ballast to12.848±0.05g. Reject overweight assembly. Verify center of mass within1mm of X48/Y406; trim ballast position in front/rear carrier windows without entering rod/rotating clearance. Source typical density does not certify this condition. Measure friction separately.
feeder.spool_interface: Manual nip inlet(16,406,238.8); output fairlead(102,406,238). Pulleys and counterweight force line shareY406. Counterweight first vertical legX48 aligns with moving pulley and symmetric carrier.

mass_admission.provenance: Density ceilings and bearing ceiling are acceptance requirements. PolyLite PLA TDS typical1.17g/cm3 supports feasibility, not guaranteed upper bounds. Steel/brass envelopes include screw shanks without thread removal. All assembled moving parts must be weighed.

mode_support_pin.instruction: Insert only at carrierZ160 to support its bottom at157 while nip is closed and the counterweight cord is switched; remove before any feeder travel.

pulley_head_reliefs.reason: Swept envelope of revolving M2 heads at radius6.5; head radius1.99 gives maximum8.49, leaving0.31 radial relief and1mm rear clearance.

cord_geometry.length_scope: Effective centerline length between attachment eyes after knot seating;350mm roughcut includes trim/knot/handling allowance. Operative length unchanged; stretch/creep admission required.

feeder.counterweight_position_rule: Solve finite-radius constant cord length at each carrier center; counterweight_low_sum_z retained as historical thin-cord reference only.

finished_interfaces.fairlead_bond_process: Room-temperature two-part epoxy on PLA/brass, actual-substrate coupon admitted before use; selected product documented in procurement. No strength inferred from metal-only680 data.
finished_interfaces.fairlead_epoxy: J-BWeld50112 ClearWeld; manufacturer generic metal/plastic applicability; actual PLA/brass coupon required;24h controlled room-temperature cure before proof

inlet_grip.model_scope: Closed physical nip fixes declared material interval. Reduce only those yarn intervals against their own pad region, including bounded0.35mm exit transition. All other hardware and free yarn contact remains. Conditional on measured compression/retention.

handoff_aperture_admission.screen: Authored minimum unobstructed target aperture, not observed yarn. Requires actual retained target loop to satisfy under load. Source gives no such bound.

handoff_trial.transition_rule: Do not execute dependent release unless preceding strand ownership is independently established. No cameras; manual inspection/test fixture for research. Automatic nonvisual proof is not implemented.
handoff_trial.path_contract: Adjacent waypoints define straight interpolation in global XYZ and scalar joints. Guide insertion/withdrawal are separate axial segments; lateral park only after withdrawal. Gate openings and support release are separate stationary operations. These are trial paths; physical yarn retention is not inferred from pose clearances.

shaft_handoff.condition: Old-loop axial coordinates remain within stated initial interval in the fabric frame while the tool moves. Requires3D contact/force validation; not an observed registration guarantee.

cloth_clamp.pose_convention: Rz(yaw) Ry(-pitch) Rx(roll); optimized center is geometric datum. Gravity uses com_body_xyz_mm.

return_pin.material_path: Free lower wrap between real upper gripping lands; radius1.95 is seed only, all interior wrap vertices unconstrained.
return_pin.stock: Inspected smooth3.000±0.005mm metal pin cut8.40±0.03mm; exact material and acceptance in manufacturing packet.
return_pin.fit: S2.50±.02; socketdepth3.00±.02; sockets3.020±.005; pin3.000±.005. Radialplay<=.015; axialendplay.01… .19; minengagement2.83; rearwall>=.93mm.
return_pin.strength_basis: At2N total transverse proofload, dmin2.995mm and freeLmax2.52mm: sigma=8FL/(pi*d^3)=.478MPa; bearing F/(2*d*2.83)=.118MPa. Printed socket creep/stiffness require admission.

cloth_clamp.datum: Geometric midpoint of jaw XZ outline and inner-face Y midplane; not measured COM

stop_spacer.material: Machined brass; two new and two end spacers; source/finish in manufacturing packet

cloth_clamp.mass_basis: Full-solid CAD volumes with PLA1.24/TPU1.22/steel7.93/brass8.53g/cm3 analytical estimate, including fastener envelopes. Not measured and not a guaranteed bound; actual assembly must be weighed/balanced and model updated before physical qualification.

front_fastener.CAD_envelope: 90degree head cone united to3mm major-diameter shaft; actual seated head must fit the finished cone and remain flush or recessed. Socket is filled conservatively.
